# Watchlist brief: 2026-09-21

## Market backdrop

The S&P 500 rose 0.36% (z-score 0.6). Strongest sector: Technology (XLK) +3.21%; weakest: Energy (XLE) -0.30%. Unusual sector moves: Technology +3.21% (z-score 2.8).

## Notable moves

### AAPL: +1.27% (z-score 0.88, volume 2.12x normal)
- **What happened:** AAPL moved +1.27% on volume 2.12x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** AAPL rose 1.27%; its sector (Technology, XLK) rose 3.21% and the S&P 500 rose 0.36%. AAPL moved in line with its sector, and the sector moved unusually against the market (z-score 4.9), so this looks like a sector-wide move.
- **Likely why:** A sector-wide rally in technology stocks. [Sample Wire](https://news.example.com/2026-09-21/aapl-sector)

- **Likely why:** A sector-wide rally in technology stocks. [Sample Wire](https://news.example.com/2026-09-21/msft-sector)

### NVDA: -13.81% (z-score -4.75, volume 2.47x normal)
- **What happened:** NVDA moved -13.81% on volume 2.47x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** NVDA fell 13.81%; its sector (Technology, XLK) rose 3.21% and the S&P 500 rose 0.36%. That is 17.02 points worse than its sector, an unusual gap for NVDA (z-score -6.3), so the move looks specific to NVDA.
- **Likely why:** Quarterly results missed expectations. [Sample Wire](https://news.example.com/2026-09-21/nvda-earnings)
